pattern: GOV.UK error summary: a focusable, labelled region with a native heading and a list of in-page links to the invalid fields.

aria.value: -1, so the summary can receive programmatic focus without entering the Tab order

keyboard.action: Moves between the summary links and the rest of the page.
Focuses the target (or calls its focus callback), scrolls it to the center, and emits aui-navigate.

focus: show() moves focus to the summary and scrolls it into view (focusOnShow). The host shows the shared focus ring on :focus-visible; links have their own 1px-offset focus ring.
notes: Focusing the summary makes screen readers announce the region name (the heading) and its contents once; no live region is used.
Link activation prevents the fragment navigation, so the URL hash does not change and focus lands on the control, not its container.
Links are underlined and error-colored; color is not the only cue.
Choose headingLevel to fit the page's heading outline.
knownCaveats: Announcement on focus has not yet been manually verified with NVDA, JAWS, and VoiceOver.
